base: Create one professional 3D game prop concept design sheet with EXACTLY TWO distinct complete variants side by side, left A and right B, large and equally readable with ample separation. Plain warm light gray studio background, soft contact shadows, no environment. Consistent 3/4 view, entire objects uncropped, no inset views. Stylized polished low-poly aesthetic, beveled readable shapes, moderate detail suitable for modeling in Blender for a luxurious auction house with teal walls, warm walnut and antique brass. No photoreal clutter. Small simple labels 'A' and 'B' below respective objects, no other text. This is a paired design comparison sheet, not a room scene.
pairs: 01_Rope_Barrier

Access restriction barrier set. A: polished brass round stanchions with burgundy velvet rope and heavy circular bases. B: dark walnut square posts with brass finials and teal braided rope. Each variant show a complete three-post two-rope short barrier.
02_Bench
Backless upholstered benches. A: burgundy tufted cushion, walnut straight legs, brass feet. B: deep teal smooth cushion on elegantly curved walnut frame with subtle brass trim.
03_Chair

Individual chairs. A: burgundy upholstered armless auction chair, walnut tall rectangular back, brass corner caps. B: teal upholstered reading armchair with slim walnut arms and modest carved back. Human scale.
04_Sofa
Sofas. A: three-seat curved teal velvet sofa with walnut base and brass feet. B: two-seat burgundy Chesterfield leather sofa, tufted back and rolled arms.
05_Planter

Potted plants including vessels. A: full graceful indoor palm in round dark teal glazed pot with brass rim. B: neatly shaped broadleaf indoor tree in square paneled walnut planter with brass feet. Both plants entirely visible.
06_Round_Table

Large round tables. A: walnut circular salon table on ornate central pedestal, brass edge. B: circular dark green marble-top table on four walnut legs joined by curved stretcher, brass caps. Table surfaces empty.
07_Side_Table

Small round side tables. A: compact round walnut end table on three splayed legs with small lower shelf and brass trim. B: compact round ivory marble top on elegant brass tripod with round lower stretcher. Surfaces empty.
08_Service_Trolley

Wheeled service trolleys. A: two-tier polished brass tea trolley with walnut trays, four caster wheels and curved push handle. B: compact dark walnut three-tier serving cart with brass railings and side handle. Empty trays so geometry is readable.
09_Picture_Light

Wall-mounted picture lights. A: long cylindrical antique brass horizontal picture lamp on two short curved wall arms with mounting plates. B: slim dark bronze rectangular horizontal shade with brass interior on a central angled arm and wall plate. Show fixtures alone, no paintings, no walls. Both plausible mount and downward illumination direction.
10_Cushion

Decorative cushions. A: square teal velvet cushion embroidered with a gold botanical medallion and gold piping. B: burgundy rectangular lumbar cushion with subtle gold diamond pattern and short corner tassels.
11_Table

Rectangular tables. A: walnut low rectangular coffee table, brass border and lower shelf, rounded corners. B: full-height walnut reading/appraisal table with dark green inset felt top and two shallow drawers, brass pulls. Empty surfaces.
12_Bookcase

Freestanding bookcases. A: tall walnut bookcase with three open shelves of antique books and two closed lower cabinet doors, brass handles. B: wide lower walnut library bookcase with open cubbies, books and central glass-front compartment. Entire furniture visible.
13_Shelf

Display shelving. A: freestanding narrow walnut and brass open étagère with four empty shelves, delicate arched top. B: wall-mounted three-level walnut display shelves on ornate brass brackets, no wall rendered. Shelves empty.
14_Ornament

Collectible decorative tabletop ornaments. A: antique brass armillary sphere mounted on square walnut base, coherent nested rings and central globe. B: small bronze rearing horse sculpture on dark green marble plinth, elegant readable silhouette.
